rationale: Best balance: level is perfectly decodable at L22 (mean-diff AUC 1.0, logistic 0.89 vs 0.58 shuffled), self-gate separates on train, style gap 0.129 of state norm with consistent family cosines (0.47-0.67); alpha ~0.9x the natural style gap so the model's own level reading drives the shift.

Largest style gap (0.144) and most consistent simplification direction across families (min cosine 0.448), level decodable (mean-diff AUC 1.0); self-gate unavailable here, so use the metadata-parsed external gate at ~0.7x the style gap to leave room for later layers to repair grammar.

Conservative low-strength control at the same site as c1 (~half the style gap) to test whether a gentle push widens the A1/B2 complexity gap without the grammar/naturalness loss seen with the strong prompt; also isolates gate type vs c1.

Late-site, self-gated alternative: self-gate available and highest cos(a,b)=0.186, but level decodability is weaker at final (AUC ~0.78) and family consistency lower (min 0.353), so use a moderate alpha (~0.75x gap 0.109) acting directly on lexical choice via W_head b.
